author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: I want the logging and observability pipeline brought under the security team’s review. The more formal the governance on that pipeline, the better, because it directly protects our compliance posture when loyalty basket data flows through the logs. I am asking for a strict sign off process for every change to that infrastructure. I would be happy to see that process expanded further if it strengthens our audit trail. This is a clear requirement for the platform to operate safely, and I welcome any additional controls the security team deems necessary to keep our data handling airtight.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that expanding the process further if it strengthens the audit trail would make them happier, indicating that exceeding the minimum ask aligns with their underlying goal of maximizing security and compliance.
